description: Check what affects whether this workspace's mail reaches the inbox: bounce and complaint rates over 7 and 30 days next to the suspension thresholds, how many contacts are suppressed (hard bounce or complaint), the SPF/DKIM/DMARC status of custom domains, and whether the shared sending IP is on a blocklist. Use it before a bigger send, or when replies stop coming.
name: get_deliverability
title: Get deliverability
